using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.common;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class CheckpointStoreTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_CallsLogTrace_ForIndexTokenDeletion()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<CheckpointStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            
            var entry = new CheckpointEntry
            {
                metadata = new CheckpointMetadata
                {
                    storeHlogToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    storeIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    objectStoreHlogToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    objectStoreIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid()
                }
            };

            var mockCkptManagerMain = new Mock<IRecoveryCheckpointManager>();
            mockCkptManagerMain.Setup(m => m.GetIndexCheckpointTokens())
                .Returns(new[] { Guid.NewGuid(), entry.metadata.storeIndexToken, Guid.NewGuid() });
            
            var mockCkptManagerObject = new Mock<IRecoveryCheckpointManager>();
            mockCkptManagerObject.Setup(m => m.GetIndexCheckpointTokens())
                .Returns(new[] { Guid.NewGuid() });

            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.serverOptions).Returns(new ServerOptions { DisableObjects = false });
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(StoreType.Main))
                .Returns(mockCkptManagerMain.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(StoreType.Object))
                .Returns(mockCkptManagerObject.Object);

            var checkpointStore = new CheckpointStore(mockStoreWrapper.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object, false, mockLogger.Object)
            {
                head = entry,
                tail = entry
            };

            // Act
            checkpointStore.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry(entry);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(msg => msg.ToString().Contains("Deleting index token")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeast(2)); // At least 2 calls: one for Main store, one for Object store
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_WithObjectsDisabled_CallsLogTrace_ForMainStoreOnly()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<CheckpointStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            
            var entry = new CheckpointEntry
            {
                metadata = new CheckpointMetadata
                {
                    storeHlogToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    storeIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid()
                }
            };

            var mockCkptManagerMain = new Mock<IRecoveryCheckpointManager>();
            mockCkptManagerMain.Setup(m => m.GetIndexCheckpointTokens())
                .Returns(new[] { Guid.NewGuid(), entry.metadata.storeIndexToken });

            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.serverOptions).Returns(new ServerOptions { DisableObjects = true });
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(StoreType.Main))
                .Returns(mockCkptManagerMain.Object);

            var checkpointStore = new CheckpointStore(mockStoreWrapper.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object, false, mockLogger.Object)
            {
                head = entry,
                tail = entry
            };

            // Act
            checkpointStore.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry(entry);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(msg => msg.ToString().Contains("Deleting index token")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Exactly(1)); // Only Main store
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class CheckpointStoreLoggerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_LogsIndexTokenDeletion_WhenExtraIndexTokensExist()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace)).Returns(true);
            
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.serverOptions).Returns(new Garnet.server.ServerOptions { DisableObjects = true });
            
            var mockCkptManager = new Mock<Garnet.server.IRecoveryCheckpointManager>();
            mockCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetIndexCheckpointTokens())
                .Returns(new[] { Guid.NewGuid(), Guid.NewGuid() }); // Two tokens to delete
            
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(It.IsAny<Garnet.common.StoreType>()))
                .Returns(mockCkptManager.Object);
            
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<Garnet.server.StoreWrapper>();
            
            var checkpointStore = new CheckpointStore(mockStoreWrapper.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object, false, mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            checkpointStore.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry();

            // Assert - verify the specific LogTrace call on line 111
            mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogTrace(
                    "Deleting index token {toDeleteIndexToken}", 
                    It.IsAny<Guid>()),
                Times.Exactly(2)); // Called for each index token to delete
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_LogsLogTokenDeletion_WhenExtraLogTokensExist()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace)).Returns(true);
            
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.serverOptions).Returns(new Garnet.server.ServerOptions { DisableObjects = true });
            
            var mockCkptManager = new Mock<Garnet.server.IRecoveryCheckpointManager>();
            mockCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetLogCheckpointTokens())
                .Returns(new[] { Guid.NewGuid(), Guid.NewGuid() }); // Two tokens to delete
            
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(It.IsAny<Garnet.common.StoreType>()))
                .Returns(mockCkptManager.Object);
            
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<Garnet.server.StoreWrapper>();
            
            var checkpointStore = new CheckpointStore(mockStoreWrapper.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object, false, mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            checkpointStore.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry();

            // Assert - verify the LogTrace call for log tokens (line ~103)
            mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogTrace(
                    "Deleting log token {toDeletelogToken}", 
                    It.IsAny<Guid>()),
                Times.Exactly(2));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_NoLogTraceCalls_WhenNoExtraTokens()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace)).Returns(true);
            
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.serverOptions).Returns(new Garnet.server.ServerOptions { DisableObjects = true });
            
            var mockCkptManager = new Mock<Garnet.server.IRecoveryCheckpointManager>();
            mockCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetLogCheckpointTokens()).Returns(Array.Empty<Guid>());
            mockCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetIndexCheckpointTokens()).Returns(Array.Empty<Guid>());
            
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(It.IsAny<Garnet.common.StoreType>()))
                .Returns(mockCkptManager.Object);
            
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<Garnet.server.StoreWrapper>();
            
            var checkpointStore = new CheckpointStore(mockStoreWrapper.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object, false, mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            checkpointStore.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry();

            // Assert - no LogTrace calls when no tokens to delete
            mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogTrace(
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()),
                Times.Never);
        }
    }
}
